entities.name: Issabela Al-Ahd
entities.description: Once kind, later an emotionally detached assassin after her demotion from the Nullborn.
entities.quote: Issabela Al-Ahd (real name: Zaynab) — once kind, later an emotionally detached assassin after her demotion from the Nullborn.

entities.name: Rahim Al-Ahd
entities.description: Father of Issabela and head of the family in her era.
entities.quote: Rahim Al-Ahd — father of Issabela, head of the family in her era.

entities.name: Anna Al-Ahd
entities.description: Issabela’s sister and legendary wielder of the ancestral sword that passes through chosen heirs.
entities.quote: Anna Al-Ahd — Issabela’s sister; legendary wielder of the ancestral sword that passes through chosen heirs.

entities.name: Nusrat
entities.description: Unrelated by blood to the Al-Ahds but destined to inherit Anna’s sword after Nawshin.
entities.quote: Nusrat — unrelated by blood but destined to inherit Anna’s sword after Nawshin.

entities.name: Liam Aldercrest
entities.description: Ancestor of Rohan whose magical lineage carries into modern times.
entities.quote: Liam Aldercrest (true name revealed later in lore) — ancestor of Rohan, his magical lineage carries into modern times.

entities.name: Rohan Aldercrest
entities.description: Inherits the magical and strategic brilliance of the Aldercrest family.
entities.quote: Rohan Aldercrest — “The Arcane Tactician,” inherits the magical and strategic brilliance of the family.

entities.name: Fahad Duskmoor
entities.description: Descendant of Silas Duskmoor who inherits fiery combat prowess and frontline strength.
entities.quote: Fahad Duskmoor (descendant) — inherits fiery combat prowess, frontline strength.

entities.name: Agnus El-Mansur
entities.description: Feared general with a legacy of calculated cruelty; father to Jubayer and Tamim.
entities.quote: Agnus El-Mansur — feared general with a legacy of calculated cruelty; father to Jubayer and Tamim.

entities.name: Jubayer
entities.description: Lightning wielder who inherits aspects of El-Mansur tactical ferocity.
entities.quote: Jubayer — lightning wielder (Duskblade), inherits aspects of El-Mansur tactical ferocity.

entities.name: Tamim
entities.description: Dagger wielder who carries El-Mansur’s calculating ruthlessness.
entities.quote: Tamim — dagger wielder (The Dagger Wolf), also carries El-Mansur’s calculating ruthlessness.

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: Sealed ancient warrior; Robin is his reincarnation yet Zaan still exists.
entities.quote: Zaan — The Immortal Stormblade — sealed ancient warrior; Robin is his reincarnation yet Zaan still exists.

entities.name: Jessy
entities.description: Ancient entity whose power was beyond mortal comprehension, fought by the Nine Clans.
entities.quote: Jessy as a Dragon: She herself was a divine or celestial dragon in human form.

entities.name: Ramiz
entities.description: Belonged to Al-Ahd and acted as a Guardian of a fragment of the Cube in his era.
entities.quote: Ramiz (Al-Ahd) and Agnus (El-Mansur) acted as Guardians of fragments of the Cube in their era.

entities.name: Madhobi
entities.description: Nature Guardian confirmed to exist across multiple eras, hinting at a spirit, immortal, or recurring reincarnation.
entities.quote: Madhobi — Nature Guardian, confirmed to exist in Zaan’s time, Khalid’s time, Issabela’s era, and the present day.

entities.name: Ariyan
entities.description: Character having beast morph powers who can inherit mythical beast morphing if he defeats any.
entities.quote: ariyan having beast morph powers and also mentioned he can inherit mythical beast morphing if he defeats any

entities.name: Nur
entities.description: Born by Mephistopheles' offering, direct descendant of the demonic clan with pure demonic blood.
entities.quote: Nur as the demon child, born by maphistoes offering is direct decendent of that clan.

entities.name: Al-Ahd
entities.description: Known for discipline, loyalty, and unshakable resolve, carrying a sacred vow through generations.
entities.quote: Al-Ahd Known for: Ancient oath-bound warriors and leaders; legacy of discipline, loyalty, and unshakable resolve.

entities.name: Aldercrest
entities.description: Mystics with refined magical bloodlines, known for arcane intelligence and political influence.
entities.quote: Aldercrest Known for: Mystics and arcane tacticians with refined magical bloodlines; often rise to positions of scholarly or battlefield leadership.

entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: Known for battles against colossal beasts, extreme combat endurance, and divine fire abilities.
entities.quote: Duskmoor Known for: Dragon hunters and slayers, fire wielders; often shrouded in myth for their battles against colossal beasts.

entities.name: El-Mansur
entities.description: Characterized by brutal yet calculated dominance, imperial military tradition, and physical prowess.
entities.quote: El-Mansur Known for: Conquerors and war tacticians; brutal yet calculated dominance on the battlefield.

entities.name: Nine Clans
entities.description: The nine superior clans that fought Jessy during her prime in a war lasting seven days and nights.
entities.quote: The 9 Superior Clans fought Jessy during her prime, in a war that raged for seven days and nights.

timeline_events.title: War of the Nine Clans Against Jessy
timeline_events.description: The Nine Clans fought Jessy during her prime in a war lasting seven days and nights, eventually sealing her soul.
timeline_events.quote: The 9 Superior Clans fought Jessy during her prime, in a war that raged for seven days and nights. Their combined might could not kill her, but they succeeded in sealing her soul.
